business_problem: ClipChat needed to replace slow, manually stitched music-video production with a workflow that could follow song structure, keep creator identity consistent across scenes, and output multiple distribution formats without the 4-8 week timelines and costs of a traditional shoot.
solution_summary: ClipChat rebuilt its AI music video studio around Seedance 2.5 as the core "director model" while keeping a broader orchestration layer for language, image, and voice work. Tracks enter the workflow through an upload step that performs roughly 60 seconds of genre, mood, and lyric analysis; creators then refine ideas in plain language and approve a free scene-by-scene storyboard before rendering. Seedance 2.5 handles the key production step by listening to verse, chorus, and drop structure, generating 20-scene clips that stay aligned to a five-angle identity sheet and maintain facial consistency from first frame to final cut. Supporting services including Claude, Minimax H3, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, and Seedream 5 Pro fill in adjacent language, image, and voice tasks. The finished render is automatically repackaged into social snippets, a full YouTube video, and a streaming-ready cutdown for same-day publishing.
